verdict.rationale: Skyvern publishes a dedicated versioning and deprecation page. It commits to at least 6 months notice before an endpoint is sunset, at least 12 months before a major version is removed, RFC 9745/8594 Deprecation/Sunset headers on deprecated endpoints, and `deprecated: true` markers in the OpenAPI spec. The API itself is path-versioned (/v1/run/tasks, /v1/run/agents) and backed by a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 document. The probe 404s at skyvern.com do not contradict this, since the spec is served at api.skyvern.com. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the deprecation policy has actually been honored in practice.
